query:
SELECT 
  CASE WHEN active = 1 THEN 'Ativo' ELSE 'Inativo' END as status,
  COUNT(*) as qtd_produtos,
  ROUND(SUM(currentStock * avgCost), 2) as valor_estoque
FROM products 
WHERE (isComposite = 0 OR isComposite IS NULL)
  AND currentStock IS NOT NULL
  AND avgCost IS NOT NULL
  AND currentStock > 0
  AND avgCost > 0
  AND companyId = 1
GROUP BY active
